name: Bunting garland
summary: String of triangular pennant flags swagged across about 800 px between two points; y is the attach height. Anim sway.

params.name: y
params.note: attach height: the y where both ends of the string are tied (the swag hangs below it)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the swag is about 800 px wide and hangs about 300 px below y

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the flags swing gently from the string

author: krakujs
